scenarios.expected: parallel children fan into a gated aggregator; every final artifact is journaled and resolvable
scenarios.observed: p1+p2 flipped ready while agg stayed declared; both succeeded, agg flipped+claimed+succeeded; 3 produce edges, 3 artifact_finalized rows, every artifact ready-resolvable; 2 agg ordering edges

scenarios.expected: session crash requeues under backoff
scenarios.observed: PROCESS_EXIT_NONZERO failed the attempt (transient); attempt_retry_scheduled; node ready with not_before set

scenarios.expected: kill loses no completed outputs; started attempts park ambiguous; reconcile precedes reinvoke
scenarios.observed: A succeeded with identical artifact checksum; B ambiguous/attempt_ambiguous; post-restart node_dispatched ordered after reconcile

scenarios.expected: rate-limit hints are honored exactly within the cap and ignored off-class
scenarios.observed: 90s hint honored (not_before in bound); 48h hint capped at the 10m policy cap; dispatch_infra report ignored its hint; terminal failure closed the node

scenarios.expected: suspect is observable-only; lost expires every held lease; clean shutdown releases
scenarios.observed: worker_suspect once at 2 beats with leases live; worker_lost at 5 beats expired both leases (idle ready, live ambiguous); shutdown released the quiet lease

scenarios.expected: never-started expiry requeues under a new lease
scenarios.observed: expired 1 never-started lease; node ready; reclaimed as attempt_seq 2; lease_expired+node_ready journaled

scenarios.expected: mid-flight expiry parks ambiguous without requeue; the stale lease fences writes
scenarios.observed: started lease expired to ambiguous/attempt_ambiguous; reclaim empty; Fence+RenewLease refused stale with lease_renewal_rejected journaled

scenarios.expected: exact replays dedupe observably; same-key different-payload replays conflict
scenarios.observed: outcome replay deduped (one attempt_succeeded, +1 command_deduped, no re-transition, replay result identical to the commit); different fingerprint conflicted DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY; re-emit returned the committed node id with no second node_declared

scenarios.expected: legal writes resolve; the four refusals fail safe with codes; live anchors refuse writes
scenarios.observed: seq-1 write resolved via token; unknown+tampered tokens stale (tampered journaled); bumped version incompatible via ResumeSubtree; mutated workspace mismatched; GC'd artifact missing; running anchor refused; every refusal left run state untouched

scenarios.expected: resume returns unfinished work claimable, parks in-flight ambiguity, and re-exposes reads without restoring payloads
scenarios.observed: preflight ok after restart; unfinished reclaimed as seq 2 and succeeded; flying parked RESUME_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_DECISION; pre-parked ambiguity untouched; ResolveProduced re-resolved X with an unchanged produce set

scenarios.expected: cancel cascades: live nodes signal, ready/declared cancel, ambiguity parks while the cascade flows past
scenarios.observed: BFS covered all 6 nodes; running kept state with cancel_requested; parent+ready+grand+ambchild cancelled; ambiguous parked untouched; re-cancel idempotent

scenarios.expected: a cyclic batch rejects atomically naming the cycle; a corrected batch commits
scenarios.observed: A->B->A rejected SPEC_VALIDATION_FAILED naming both keys with zero nodes committed; corrected A,B(dep A) created; the depth-4 child rejected MAX_DEPTH_EXCEEDED under the locked cap

scenarios.expected: budgets exhaust terminally; terminal classes land at once; managed hooks run once, unmanaged journal only
scenarios.observed: 3 transient failures exhausted (counts 3/3) RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; terminal class landed BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with the dependent declared; managed hook cleaned once + executed result, replay deduped; unmanaged request-only, executor untouched

scenarios.expected: reads gate on finalization and scope; declare-or-flag journals undeclared reads
scenarios.observed: premature read refused NOT_FINALIZED; finalize flipped the consumer; declared read released verified bytes with the checksum on the edge; double finalize refused with the recorded row standing; mismatch refused then retried clean; in-run read flagged undeclared; foreign-run read denied

scenarios.expected: one slot admits one node and defers the other; the disk floor denies; stalls surface without corrupting transitions
scenarios.observed: disk floor deferred directly (and admits a healthy snapshot); A claimed while B deferred with ready_at untouched and no attempt row; completing A dispatched B; stalled drain raised OUTBOX_PUBLISH_STALLED via flag+log+health while B's outcome committed correct

scenarios.expected: timers skip ambiguity; the operator decision is idempotent; the rerun takes a new attempt_seq
scenarios.observed: sweep past the node bounds skipped both ambiguous nodes; rerun readyed with one attempt_decision and claimed attempt_seq 2; resume replay deduped

scenarios.expected: saturation never starves: FIFO holds across re-evaluations and freeing dispatches
scenarios.observed: B held ready_at across 10 saturated re-evaluations with one entry-only deferral; freeing the slot dispatched B on the next claim

scenarios.expected: gaps and undeclared kinds flag; redelivery dedupes; every scenario run journals cataloged kinds
scenarios.observed: contiguous fold clean, gapped fold flagged EVENT_SEQUENCE_GAP; redelivery deduped to its seq (DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID vocabulary-bound, dedupe behaviorally proven via seq identity + single stored row); undeclared kind stored verbatim and flagged UNKNOWN_EVENT_KIND

scenarios.expected: confirmed session kill requeues retryable; unconfirmed parks ambiguous
scenarios.observed: confirmed kill landed SESSION_WALL_CLOCK_REACHED with node ready under backoff; unconfirmed kill parked attempt_ambiguous

scenarios.expected: expired node bounds land terminal; expired run bounds cancel and land; ambiguity skips both timers
scenarios.observed: node bound landed NODE_TIMEOUT under a confirmed kill (attempt SESSION_WALL_CLOCK_REACHED); amb node+run skipped; after rerun the deferred node timer fired and the run landed WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT over the cancelled cascade
